sources.site: USGS 50092000 RIO GRANDE DE PATILLAS NR PATILLAS, PR
USGS 50093000 RIO MARIN NR PATILLAS, PR

blockers: Lago Patillas is located at the confluence of Rio Grande de Patillas and Rio Marin; both tributary components must be admitted before composite inflow is derived
instantaneous values must pass revision, calibration, uncertainty, interval-alignment and source-hash gates
local ungauged runoff between gauges and reservoir must be quantified, modeled with uncertainty, or proven immaterial for the chosen boundary

inputs.source: USGS 50093045 LAGO PATILLAS AT DAMSITE NEAR PATILLAS, PR
blockers: instantaneous observations must be accepted-current rather than provisional
measurement uncertainty and calibration evidence must be bound to each stage observation

inputs.source: USGS 50093053 CANAL DE PATILLAS AT FOREBAY plus USGS 50093045 gate-opening context
blockers: forebay gauge is downstream of the outlet works
gate-opening height is not discharge without an authoritative rating/operation relation
intervening canal gain/loss cannot be silently absorbed

inputs.source: USGS 50093120 RIO GRANDE DE PATILLAS BLW LAGO PATILLAS, PR
blockers: instantaneous records must pass revision/calibration/uncertainty gates
topology must determine which outlet/spill pathways are represented at this gauge
this term may not be assumed zero merely because irrigation releases normally enter the canal

inputs.source: Puerto Rico Statistics / AAA Untreated Water Extractions and Production
inputs.parameter: average monthly raw-water extraction/production in MGD by plant
blockers: monthly-average publication is too coarse for a 15-minute slice
USGS 50093075 minus 50093078 is only a derived diversion estimate when synchronized and is not a direct plant meter

inputs.source: USGS 50093078 below Guayama Filtration Plant and USGS 50093083 above AES intake
blockers: neither station is proven to be the terminal canal boundary
all downstream diversions must be enumerated or the boundary moved to a measured point
instantaneous records must pass revision/calibration/uncertainty gates

inputs.source: NOAA/NWS MRMS Caribbean precipitation products plus USGS 50093045 point precipitation
blockers: freeze water-surface geometry applicable to each stage or an authoritative stage-area relation
clip and area-weight MRMS cells for the exact interval
quantify QPE and geometry uncertainty; retain point gauge as cross-check

inputs.source: USGS historical Puerto Rico evaporation climatology and meteorological precursors
blockers: historical pan evaporation is not a synchronized open-water measurement
modeled interval evaporation requires meteorological inputs, model version, water-surface area and uncertainty
no current direct public Lago Patillas interval evaporation stream was found

inputs.source: AEE/PREPA public transition and historical operational documents
blockers: no synchronized public flushing, leakage, maintenance-discharge or other operational-loss volumes found
unmeasured conveyance loss must not be inserted as a balancing term

public_context_findings: USGS reports Lago Patillas at the confluence of Rio Grande de Patillas and Rio Marin and irrigation releases through outlet works into the Patillas Irrigation Canal.
USGS 50093000 supplies a public Rio Marin discharge record, closing a previously identified tributary-source gap at the source-discovery level.
USGS 50093120 supplies public discharge below Lago Patillas and is retained as a separate reservoir river-outlet/spill term rather than silently assuming canal-only outflow.
AAA public statistics provide monthly-average plant extraction/production, not synchronized interval plant-meter data.
AEE/PREPA public material confirms multiple canal consumers but no synchronized operational-loss ledger was found.
